record.field: Read-only on assemblies, agenda, delegations, votings, results. Read/write/create attendees (no unlink); record rules limit attendee rows to the user's own partner, so bulk or third-party lines are blocked at rule level. May create own voting lines (cast vote); no write/unlink on those lines. Not implied by Assembly Manager; assign groups separately.

Full CRUD on assembly models (ACL). Implied by Settings / Administration (base.group_system). Does not imply Assembly User; if both groups are assigned, permissive manager ir.rule ORs with user rules so back-office rows stay visible.
